title: Pest Control Follow-Up Visit Checklist Form
subtitle: Control inspection, monitoring, exclusion, treatment, and follow-up through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete pest control follow-up visit checklist for treatment zones, devices, products, and pest observations. It connects approved pest plan, product label, and site authorization to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified pest-management technician must compare a current pest control condition with prior service evidence, decide whether it is planned, recurring, incomplete, or new, and assign the next action.

sections.title: Pest Control follow-up visit checklist closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This pest control follow-up visit checklist is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when target identification, product labeling, applicator qualification, occupant protection, weather, exposure, spill, or treatment boundary is uncertain. A pest-management compliance supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.

blocks.label: Prepared, reviewed, and accepted
blocks.guidance: A signature records accountability for the stated outcome; it does not cure missing evidence or override a stop condition.
